```yaml
name: OSV Scan & Dart Checks

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 1 * * 0' # Weekly on Sundays at 01:30 UTC

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  osv-scan:
    name: OSV-Scanner
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run OSV-Scanner
        uses: google/osv-scanner-action@v1.8.2
        with:
          scan-args: |-
            --lockfile=pubspec.lock
            --recursive

  dart-checks:
    name: Dart Analyze & Format
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.x'
          channel: 'stable'

      - name: Get dependencies
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Run dart format
        run: dart format . --set-exit-if-changed

      - name: Run flutter analyze
        run: flutter analyze
```
